messages:
hazel: Playoff pool reminder  bracket picks locked at tip-off tomorrow. Post changes here if you want to trade picks before then. $8 buy-in. :moneybag: 

diego: I'm tempted to trade my #2 seed for @anna's sleeper pick. Anyone run fairness math on this?

aisha: Quick heuristic: compare projected points + upset probability. or just rock-paper-scissors it. :shrug:

matt: Trade vote thread: post both proposed swaps and react :white_check_mark: to approve. Majority wins.

anna: I'll swap my round 2 pick (Team K) for @diego's round 3 (Team S) if Diego covers snack duty Friday. :pretzel:
diego: Deal. I'll bring pretzels and hummus. DM me $8 winners also.

hazel: Note: community-bot will record approved trades when you post the emoji. Don't PM trades.

community-bot: Tip: post trades in this thread and use :white_check_mark: to signal approval. I will log the final roster at 15m before tip-off.

aisha: Also, who's using the office TV for live stream? I can set up Chromecast if needed.
matt: I'll reserve the conference nook at 7pm. Streaming ok. I'll queue up the 'good luck' playlist.

anna: Poll: wings vs sandwiches for viewing snacks. React :one: wings, :two: sandwiches, :three: salads

diego: :one:

aisha: :two: (but will bring fruit)
matt: :one:

hazel: :three: (I brought salads last time and nobody ate them but hey)

anna: Wings win. I'll order 2 trays; DMing for $4.50 each.

diego: Pro tip: mute league chat during games unless you want to be roasted for bad waiver moves. Learned that the hard way. :flushed: 

aisha: Noted. Also shoutout to @matt for patience with the last trade veto convo. Appreciate y'all keeping it civil. :clap:

matt: Thanks! Happy to referee if needed. See you all tomorrow — may the best bracket not choke. :crossed_fingers:
